note: First single-differential ν_e+ν̄_e CC-inclusive cross section on argon at MicroBooNE, measured as a function of (1) electron/positron reconstructed-true energy E_e and (2) electron/positron scattering angle cosβ (β = deflection from assumed neutrino direction), using NuMI beam in FHC (neutrino) mode, flux-integrated over 2.0e20 POT (off-axis ~8deg, νe+ν̄e mixed flux, avg energies 768/961 MeV). Wiener-SVD unfolded. This is a flux-integrated differential cross section (not per-energy-bin flux unfolding). Target: per nucleon (argon; explicitly "T = number of target nucleons" in xsec formula, Eq. near main.tex line 130, and units printed as "cm^2/nucleon" in Supplemental Material tables).
